name: Sweet Spells
intro: This room is for the sweet tooth, whatever the time of day.

lectern.label: The occasion
lectern.ref: the open book on the lectern

music-box.label: The music box
music-box.moment: Lift the lid and she dances. Her tune changes with the weather.
music-box.moment_stop: Lid down. She'll wait for you.
music-box.moment_quiet: Lift the lid and she dances. Turn the sound on, by the bell, and you'll hear her tune.

jar-tart.bridge: I haven't written the tart down. A crumble's the easy cousin.
jar-tart.label: The fruit tart
jar-tart.moment: Mostly fruit, held together with a bit of pastry and a lot of nerve.
moments: Whatever fruit is good that week goes on top.
The pastry's baked blind first, so the bottom stays crisp.

jar-truffles.label: The truffles
jar-truffles.moment: Dates and cocoa, rolled by hand. Nobody believes me about the dates.

jar-pavlova.label: The pavlova
jar-pavlova.moment: Crisp outside, soft in the middle. Yoghurt on top instead of all that cream.
moments: Kiwis and Australians both claim it. I just make it and keep quiet.
It cools in the oven with the door shut. It sulks if you rush it.

jar-parfait.label: The parfait
jar-parfait.moment: Yoghurt, berries and something crunchy, in layers. Pudding or breakfast, you decide.

sugar-pan.label: The sugar pan
sugar-pan.moment: Berries cooking down with a spoon of honey. That's the pink steam.

lane-window.label: The lane
lane-window.moment: The bakery over the road. We're friendly rivals.
moments: Their loaves smell better than mine. I say that quietly.
We trade tins when one of us runs short.

window-seat.label: The window seat
window-seat.moment: Best seat in the house for watching the lane go by.
moments: There's a dent in the cushion that's mine, and a smaller one that isn't.
The lane's never quiet for long.

star-chart.label: The star chart
star-chart.moment: The kitchen constellations. That one's the Great Whisk.
moments: The Great Whisk. Every kitchen's got one overhead.
That faint cluster is the Sieve.

atoms.title: Banana and oat pancakes
atoms.hook: Banana, eggs and oats, blended and cooked in small rounds.
atoms.method_short: A ripe banana, two eggs and a handful of oats, blended and cooked in small rounds. Berries on top.

seed.name: Banana and oat pancakes
seed.why: A sweet breakfast with no added sugar.

atoms.body: A ripe banana, two eggs and a handful of oats, blended and cooked in small rounds. Berries on top.

atoms.title: A parfait in a glass
atoms.hook: Yoghurt, berries and granola in layers, in a nice glass.
atoms.method_short: Yoghurt, berries and granola in layers, in a nice glass. Pudding or breakfast, you decide.

seed.name: Berry and yoghurt parfait
seed.why: A sweet start to the day.

atoms.body: Yoghurt, berries and granola in layers, in a nice glass. Pudding or breakfast, you decide.

atoms.title: Date and cocoa truffles
atoms.hook: Dates, almonds and cocoa, rolled into little truffles.
atoms.method_short: Soft dates, nuts and cocoa blitzed until they clump, rolled into balls and dusted in more cocoa.

seed.name: Date and cocoa truffles
seed.why: Something chocolatey to have with a cup of tea.

atoms.body: Soft dates, nuts and cocoa blitzed until they clump, rolled into balls and dusted in more cocoa.

atoms.title: Lemon and yoghurt loaf
atoms.hook: A yoghurt and lemon loaf with a sharp lemon drizzle.
atoms.method_short: A simple loaf made with yoghurt and lemon zest, with a sharp lemon drizzle. Good with a cup of tea.

seed.name: Lemon and yoghurt drizzle loaf
seed.why: An afternoon tea cake to share.

atoms.body: A simple loaf made with yoghurt and lemon zest, with a sharp lemon drizzle. Good with a cup of tea.

atoms.title: Strawberries dipped in dark chocolate
atoms.hook: Strawberries half-dipped in dark chocolate and left to set.
atoms.method_short: Strawberries dipped halfway in melted dark chocolate and left on baking paper to set.

seed.name: Dark chocolate dipped strawberries
seed.why: Fruit first, chocolate second.

atoms.body: Strawberries dipped halfway in melted dark chocolate and left on baking paper to set.

atoms.title: One-ingredient banana ice cream
atoms.hook: Frozen banana blitzed until thick and smooth, like soft serve.
atoms.wait: a few hours to freeze the bananas
atoms.method_short: Frozen banana slices blitzed until thick and smooth, like soft serve.

seed.name: Banana nice cream
seed.why: Ice cream from one ingredient on a hot day.

atoms.body: Frozen banana slices blitzed until thick and smooth, like soft serve.

atoms.title: Frozen yoghurt bark
atoms.hook: Yoghurt, berries and pistachios, frozen and snapped into shards.
atoms.method_short: Thick yoghurt spread on a tray with berries, nuts and honey, frozen and snapped into shards.

seed.name: Frozen yoghurt and berry bark
seed.why: A cold treat to keep in the freezer.

atoms.body: Thick yoghurt spread on a tray with berries, nuts and honey, frozen and snapped into shards.

atoms.title: Mango and lime ice lollies
atoms.hook: Mango and lime, blended and frozen into lollies.
atoms.method_short: Ripe mango blended with lime juice, poured into moulds and frozen. Expect sticky fingers.

seed.name: Mango and lime ice lollies
seed.why: Cold, fruity and made ahead for a hot day.

atoms.body: Ripe mango blended with lime juice, poured into moulds and frozen. Expect sticky fingers.

atoms.title: Baked pears with ginger and maple
atoms.hook: Pears baked with ginger and maple, with coconut yoghurt on top.
atoms.method_short: Halved pears with grated ginger and maple syrup, baked for twenty-five minutes. A spoon of coconut yoghurt on top.

seed.name: Baked pears with ginger and maple
seed.why: A warm, simple pudding.

atoms.body: Halved pears with grated ginger and maple syrup, baked for twenty-five minutes. A spoon of coconut yoghurt on top.

atoms.title: Fruit crumble with an oat top
atoms.hook: Soft fruit under a crunchy oat and hazelnut top.
atoms.method_short: Soft fruit in a dish under a crumbly top of oats, flour, butter and nuts. Bake until it bubbles at the edges.

seed.name: Apple and berry crumble with an oat top
seed.why: A warm pudding that uses up fruit.

atoms.body: Soft fruit in a dish under a crumbly top of oats, flour, butter and nuts. Bake until it bubbles at the edges.

atoms.title: Chocolate pots for later
atoms.hook: Dark chocolate and coconut milk, set in small cups in the fridge.
atoms.method_short: Dairy-free dark chocolate melted into warm coconut milk, poured into small cups and left in the fridge. Ready in a couple of hours.

seed.name: Little dark chocolate pots
seed.why: Ten minutes to make, then waiting in the fridge for later.

atoms.body: Dairy-free dark chocolate melted into warm coconut milk, poured into small cups and left in the fridge. Ready in a couple of hours.

atoms.title: Little pavlovas with yoghurt and berries
atoms.hook: Little meringue nests with yoghurt and berries.
atoms.method_short: Small meringue nests, baked low and slow, filled with thick yoghurt and berries just before serving.

seed.name: Mini pavlovas with yoghurt and berries
seed.why: A pudding to share at a celebration.

atoms.body: Small meringue nests, baked low and slow, filled with thick yoghurt and berries just before serving.

steps: Break off one square of chocolate.
Put it on your tongue and let it melt.
Have the almonds with it, and a few grains of salt if you like.

atoms.title: One square of dark chocolate, slowly
atoms.hook: One square of dark chocolate, left to melt slowly.
atoms.method_short: Break off one square of dark chocolate and let it melt on your tongue. It lasts longer than you'd think.

seed.name: Dark chocolate and almond bark
seed.why: A slab to break one square from at a time.

atoms.body: Break off one square of dark chocolate and let it melt on your tongue. It lasts longer than you'd think.

atoms.title: Why whole fruit is the gentlest sweet
atoms.hook: Whole fruit brings fibre and water along with its sugar.
atoms.method_short: Whole fruit brings fibre and water with its sugar, so it fills you up and goes in more slowly than sugar on its own.

seed.name: Roast stone fruit with yoghurt
seed.why: Fruit as the pudding.

atoms.body: Whole fruit brings fibre and water with its sugar, so it fills you up and goes in more slowly than sugar on its own.

steps: Chocolate: sprinkle a pinch of flaky salt on top.
Berries: grate a little lemon zest over them.
Yoghurt: toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes and scatter them on top.

atoms.title: Level up any sweet spell
atoms.hook: Salt on chocolate, zest on berries, toasted nuts on yoghurt.
atoms.method_short: A pinch of flaky salt on chocolate, lemon zest on berries, toasted nuts on yoghurt. Small changes you can taste.

seed.name: Berries with lemon zest and toasted almonds
seed.why: Three small finishes on one bowl.

atoms.body: A pinch of flaky salt on chocolate, lemon zest on berries, toasted nuts on yoghurt. Small changes you can taste.

atoms.title: Roast rhubarb with yoghurt
atoms.hook: Pink rhubarb roasted with honey and orange, over thick yoghurt.
atoms.method_short: Cut rhubarb into short lengths, roast with honey and orange zest for fifteen minutes, and spoon over yoghurt.

seed.name: Roast rhubarb with honey and yoghurt
seed.why: Rhubarb is one of the first sweet things of spring.

atoms.body: Cut rhubarb into short lengths, roast with honey and orange zest for fifteen minutes, and spoon over yoghurt.

atoms.title: Grilled peaches with honey
atoms.hook: Halved peaches, grilled until soft, with honey and yoghurt.
atoms.method_short: Halve and stone the peaches, grill cut side up until soft and browned, then add honey, yoghurt and a little thyme.

seed.name: Grilled peaches with honey and thyme
seed.why: Ripe summer peaches, warm from the grill.

atoms.body: Halve and stone the peaches, grill cut side up until soft and browned, then add honey, yoghurt and a little thyme.

atoms.title: Feijoa fool
atoms.hook: Feijoa pulp folded through thick yoghurt with a little honey.
atoms.method_short: Scoop out the feijoas and mash with honey and a squeeze of lime. Fold loosely through yoghurt and spoon into glasses.

seed.name: Feijoa fool
seed.why: Feijoas for a few weeks in autumn, at their simplest.

atoms.body: Scoop out the feijoas and mash with honey and a squeeze of lime. Fold loosely through yoghurt and spoon into glasses.

atoms.title: Tamarillos poached in honey
atoms.hook: Tamarillos poached in honey and orange until soft and ruby red.
atoms.method_short: Pour boiling water over the tamarillos and slip off the skins. Simmer in honey, orange juice and cinnamon for ten minutes.

seed.name: Tamarillos poached in honey and orange
seed.why: Tamarillos are a winter fruit, sharp until they meet some honey.

atoms.body: Pour boiling water over the tamarillos and slip off the skins. Simmer in honey, orange juice and cinnamon for ten minutes.

atoms.title: Anzac biscuits
atoms.hook: Oat and coconut biscuits, chewy in the middle.
atoms.method_short: Melt butter and golden syrup, then stir in the oats, flour, coconut and sugar with bicarb dissolved in hot water. Roll into balls, flatten and bake until golden.

seed.name: Anzac biscuits
seed.why: Oats, coconut and golden syrup, baked until chewy. Good with a cup of tea.

atoms.body: Melt butter and golden syrup, then stir in the oats, flour, coconut and sugar with bicarb dissolved in hot water. Roll into balls, flatten and bake until golden.

atoms.title: Hokey pokey
atoms.hook: Crunchy golden honeycomb, broken into shards.
atoms.method_short: Boil sugar and golden syrup to a deep gold, then whisk in baking soda off the heat. Pour into a lined tin, cool and break into pieces. Hot sugar burns, so keep little ones back.

seed.name: Hokey pokey honeycomb
seed.why: The crunchy gold in Kiwi ice cream. Crisp, sweet and not much to it.

atoms.body: Boil sugar and golden syrup to a deep gold, then whisk in baking soda off the heat. Pour into a lined tin, cool and break into pieces. Hot sugar burns, so keep little ones back.

atoms.title: Chocolate bananas in foil
atoms.hook: Bananas split, filled with dark chocolate and baked in foil.
atoms.method_short: Slit each banana along its curve, push in squares of dark chocolate and wrap tight in foil. Eight minutes on the barbecue or in a hot oven, then eat it from the skin with a spoon.

seed.name: Foil-baked chocolate bananas
seed.why: Campfire pudding, no campfire required.

atoms.body: Slit each banana along its curve, push in squares of dark chocolate and wrap tight in foil. Eight minutes on the barbecue or in a hot oven, then eat it from the skin with a spoon.

atoms.title: Grilled pineapple with honey and lime
atoms.hook: Thick pineapple rings, brushed with honey and grilled until marked.
atoms.method_short: Cut pineapple into thick rings, brush with honey and grill until marked and caramelised at the edges. Lime juice and torn mint at the end.

seed.name: Grilled pineapple with honey, lime and mint
seed.why: The grill concentrates the sweetness, and the lime pulls it back.

atoms.body: Cut pineapple into thick rings, brush with honey and grill until marked and caramelised at the edges. Lime juice and torn mint at the end.

atoms.title: Slow-cooker rice pudding
atoms.hook: Pudding rice and milk left on low until creamy, with nutmeg.
atoms.method_short: Pudding rice, milk, sugar and vanilla in the pot, on low for three hours, stirring once if you pass. Grate a little nutmeg on top.

seed.name: Slow-cooker vanilla rice pudding
seed.why: The old school-dinner pudding, only better behaved.

atoms.body: Pudding rice, milk, sugar and vanilla in the pot, on low for three hours, stirring once if you pass. Grate a little nutmeg on top.
